text: wsl-claude: synced, understood, and it can be synced AND encrypted: the encrypted archive syncs to Drive exactly like any file, so you still get the extra off-machine copy. The only difference is whether Google can read what's inside. So the one question still open is only that: encrypted (Google gets a sealed blob; you keep a passphrase) or plain (Google can read your node's key and messages). Either way it syncs.
